XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Component: Steering column

  • Fault: Whilst driving in a straight line, turning the steering wheel slightly causes the steering to lock up. This lasts for a few seconds, after which normal operation is restored.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty steering column

• Action: Check the condition and operation of the steering column and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the faulty component showed no visible defects. After replacement, the problem was permanently resolved. The steering column consists of an electric motor, a control unit and the column itself.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1.7 hours.
